tei:div.tei:p: 11) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig las: phur sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal mtsho rgyal thugs bcud bzhugs: 12) na mo pad+ma kā ra ye: rang rig sku gsum dbyer med pa: thod phreng rtsal la gus pas 'dud: phyi rabs skal ldan las 'phro can: zab mo gter la spyod pa'i tshe: dus ngan dbang gis bar chad mang: de tshe de yi cha rkyen du: phur sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal bstan: sa ma ya: rkyen bral yid dwangs 'tshe ba bral: byin chags bkod legs dben pa'i gnas: grogs dang mkho ba'i yo byad bsags/ rab ni rdul tshon 'bring ras bris: yang na gtor ma lha grangs sam: phur sgrub dag la brten kyang rung: de dag phyi nang mchod pas bskor: dkar dmar gnyis lhar phrin las bcol: de nas bde ba'i stan la 'khod: brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol btab mthar: de dag 'od zhu rang nyid kyi: smin 13)mtshams nas zhugs rang la thim: rang nyid rdo rje sems dpar gsal: gnas khang yo byad ji snyed kun: byin brlabs rnam dag zhing du gyur: tshogs zhing spyan drangs 'dun mkhar bskyed: sgo gsum dad pas tshig 'di brjod: dang po skyabs su 'gro ba ni: na mo: bla med bla ma yi dam lhar: mkha' 'gro chos skyong yongs 'dus dpal: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor la: byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi: lan gsum dang sems bskyed ni: hoḥ ma gyur mkha' mnyam sems can kun: rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas phyir: bdag gis rim gnyis lam bsgom nas: 'khor ba dong sprugs dpal thob shog: lan gsum brjod mthar 14) yan bdun ni: na mo: dpal chen lha tshogs dkyil 'khor du: sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa 'bul: dus gsum bsags pa'i sdig sgrib bshags: dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rangs: theg gsum chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: dam pa mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: dge tshogs 'gro ba yongs la bsngo: bla med byang chub myur thob shog: ces brjod bgegs 'dul dpa' bo'i sku:

dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: dbyu+ug to dang ni thod phrag 'dzin: khro bo'i chas rdzogs gar dgur ldan: rta mgo ljang zhur rta skad 'tsher: bgegs rnams zil gyis gnon par bsgoms: de nas bgegs la bka' bsgo ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen pad+ma he ru ka: nga ni yi dam yongs 'dus drag po'i sku: nyon cig lan chags gdon bgegs 'byung po'i tshogs: 'dod yon lnga ldan gtor ma 'di longs la: gsang sngags sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir ma 'dug par: so so rang rang gnas su phyir dengs shig: gal te mi 'gro bka' las 'da' byed na: rdo rje 'bar ba'i sprul pa khro tshogs dang: me dpung mtshon cha'i pho nya skar ltar 'khrigs: lus ngag rdul brlag rdul phran bzhin du 15)bshig: gnas 'dir ma 'dug da lta phyir dengs shig: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: u tsa ta ya phaṭa: ces dngaḥhūm̐ bzhi drag sngags sogs kyis bskrad: de nas srung gur bsgom pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ rang nyid thugs las 'phros pa yi: sprul pa thun mtshon pho nya rnams: tshur 'dus srung ba'i gur khang ni: 'khor lo rdo rje rin po che: pad+ma rgya gram me rlung mtsho: srung ba'i 'khor lor lhun gyis grub: bh+rūm̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: ces brjod nas srung ba'i 'khor los mtshams bcad pas bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad nye bar mi nus pa'i nang du bdag dang bsrung bya thams cad yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bsam: de nas byin chen dbab pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ mi gnas chos sku'i pho brang nas: chos sku kun bzang yab yum la: dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin tshogs kyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phobs: lhun grub longs sku'i zhing khams nas: bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga laḥ brda brgyud rig 'dzin tshogs kyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren= mi mjed sprul pa'i zhing khams nas: dga' rab shrī seng pad+ma 'byung: snyan brgyud rig 'dzin tshogs kyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren=

'od gsal lhun grub pho brang 16)nas: rgyal yum ye shes mtsho rgyal la: gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren= spyi gtsug bde chen 'khor lo nasaḥ rig 'dzin pad+ma las 'brel la: rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren= dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag he ru ka: rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la: rigs bzhi khro bcu za gsod dang: yi dam rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren= gnas yul dur khrod la sogs nas: mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can rnams: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren= gnas dang sgrub khang sgrub pa'i rdzas: zhing dang gzhal yas bdud rtsir rlobs: sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor mched lcam dral: dpa' bo dpa' mor byin gyis rlobs: gnas mchog 'dir ru byin phobs la: sgrub mchog rnams la dngos grub stsol: mchog dang thun mong byin chen phobs: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ e a ral+li pheṃ pheṃḥ a be sha ya a a: ces brjod pas rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i dbang byin dngos grub thams cad 'od phung kha dog lnga ldan gyi rnam par byung nas bdag dang sgrub rdzas rnams su thim pas sku gsum mnyam sbyor chen por grol bar bsam mo: de nas mchod rdzas byin brlab ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: snang 17)srid 'dod yon mchod pa'i sprin: mi zad nam mkha' mdzod du spel: ting 'dzin yid sprul lha mo yis: gar stabs 'jo sgeg rnam 'gyur gyis: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mnyes pa'i rdzas: rab 'byams zhing kun yongs khyab spel: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ shap+da rū pa sogs/ dharma sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ba liṃ ta rak+ta bo dhi tsit+ta āḥhūm̐: zhes brjod pas rang gi thugs ka nas yi ge raṃ yaṃ khaṃ dang oṃ āḥhūm̐ rnams 'phros pasaḥ mes gnyis 'dzin gyi rtog pa bsregs: rlung gi dngos por 'dzin pa'i bag chags gtor: chus dri ma thams cad bkrus par bsam:

'bru gsum gyis dngos su 'byor pa'i mchod pa phyi nang gsang ba yang gsang de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa sogs yid kyis 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtshor sprul nas sku gsung thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du brlabs par bsam moḥ de dag sngon 'gro'i las rim mo: sa ma ya: de nas dngos gzhi bsgom pa ni: āḥ chos rnams stong pa de bzhin nyid: kun snang 'gro la snying rjer brdal: rig pa rgyu yi yi ge hūm̐: de las 'od zer rab 'phros pas: 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab dang: sra mkhregs rdo rje brag chen steng: dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i dbus: 18) hūm̐ las bh+rūm̐ 'phros yongs gyur pa: rab 'jigs drag po'i gzhal yas khang: rgyan dang bkod pa yongs rdzogs shing: phyi nang rim pa gnyis su grub: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dbus: gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs bcu dang: rtsibs bzhi mu khyud dang bcas steng: byol song gtso brgyad kyis btegs khrir: pad nyi bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i steng: dbyings nas sa bon gdan la babs: de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas: tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa: g.yas zhal dkar la g.yon zhal dmar: spyan dgu sdang mig g.yo zhing 'khrugs: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: sma ra smin mar me 'od 'phro: phyag drug g.yas gnyis gser rdo rje: rtse dgu dang ni rtse lnga gdengs: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭāṃ 'dzin: mtha' gnyis 'og tu phur bu 'dril: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes: thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang: rin chen rtse bran 'od du 'bar: snyan gnyis rin chen wang mig mdzes: sku stod 19) glang chen lpags pa dang: rdo rje rin chen gshog pa gdengs: rked par zhing chen g.yang gzhi dang: sku smad stag lpags sham thabs bklubs: mi mgo lnga bcu'i do shal dang: sbrul rigs lnga yis phyag zhabs spras:

dpal dang dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: sgeg dpa' 'jigs rung rngams shing gshe: snying rje rngams zhi dpal dang ldan: zhabs bzhi 'dor stabs bdud bzhi mnan: ye shes mi dpung 'khyil klong bzhugs: bde stong gnyis su med pa'i phyir: pang g.yon 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma: mthing skya zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: g.yas pas ut+pal yab mgul 'khyud: g.yon pas thod khrag gtso la stob: gzig sham smad dkris rus rgyan gsol: khro mo'i chas rdzogs zhabs gnyis kyis: brkyang bskum yab kyi sku la 'khril: bde stong ye shes nyams rgyas g.yo: phyi rim 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng: sras mchog kī la rigs bzhi ni: dkar ser dmar ljang zhal gsum pa: spyan dgu sdang mig phyogs bcur gzigs: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril smar 20)me 'phro: dbu skra gyen brdzes thod sbrul brgyan: dur khrod chas rdzogs me dpung 'bar: phyag drug rang rtags phyag mtshan dang: rdo rje me dpung kha ṭāṃ 'dzin: mtha' gnyis gnam lcags phur pa 'dril: sku smad phyogs mdog phur dbal ni: dgra bgegs log 'dren snying gar gzir: ye shes me dpung klong du bzhugs: de yi phyi rim gnam lcags kyi: 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pad nyi dang: phyogs skyong bcu yi gdan steng du: dpal chen khro bo chen po bcu: hūm̐ kar rnam rgyal dbang dbyu+ug sngon dang: gshin rje gshed dang mi g.yo ba: rta mgrin 'dod rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil: khams gsum rgyal dang stobs po che: kun kyang zhal gsum phyag drug pa: dang pos rdo rje thod khrag 'dzin: 'og gnyis rang rtags phyag mtshan bsnams: mtha' mas ri rab phur pa 'dril: zhabs bzhi gyad kyi 'dor stabs bsgrad: dur khrod chas dang dpal chas rdzogs: rang rang yum dang gnyis med 'khril: ye shes me dpung 'khyil klong bzhugs: phyogs mtshams khra thabs za gsod rnams: rang las sprul pa'i pho nya ni: mgo brnyan sna tshogs phyag gnyis pa: gdug 21)pa'i mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs:

sku mdog yab yum cha 'dzin cing: 'gugs 'dren gsod gcod las la rngams: sgo bzhir sgo ma chen mo bzhi: rang rtags phyag mtshan phur bu 'dril: yang sprul shwa na ma bzhi dang: skyes bu ging bzhi shan pa bcas: rang rang sku mdog phyag mtshan rnams: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs chen po ru: snang stong sgyu ma'i sku ru bsgom: de ltar gsal ba'i spyi bor oṃ: mgrin par āḥdang thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer rab 'phros pasaḥ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kun: 'bru gsum rnam par spyan drangs nas: rang gi gnas gsum thim pa yis: rdo rje gsum gyi rol par smin: slar yang 'od 'phros rgyal ba rnams: rigs lnga'i rnam par spyan drangs bstim: dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag: chu yi lhag ma yar lud pa: rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan gyur: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: oṃ sarba ta thā ta wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ 22)a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ ces brjod gnas gsum byin brlabs nas: dbang lha spyan drangs rigs bdag bstim: sku gsum mnyam sbyor chen po'i dbyings: ye shes lha tshogs spyan drang phyir: spos bsreg dar ga yab rol mo dang: thod rnga rkang gling snyan dbyangs bcas: dang po spyan 'dren bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i klong dkyil nas: chos sku kun bzang rig rtsal rdzogs pa'i lha: log 'dren bdud bgegs 'joms mdzad khro bo'i sku: dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras: khro bcu yab yum za gsod pho nya dang: sgo bzhi phur srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren 'khor bcas gshegs su sol: dam sri rgyal 'gong 'dul phyir gshegs su gsol: sgrub po'i tshe srog bsring phyir= dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol phyir= drag po'i phrin las bsgrub phyir= dus kyi g.yo 'khrugs bzlog phyir=

rngams brjid drag po'i sku ru da bzhengs la: ma thogs sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: drag po mthu yi dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba sa ma ya dza dzaḥ ces brjod ye shes lha tshogs rnams: gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs 'od phung 'bar: kha ba bu yug 'tshubs bzhin byon: snang ba'i yul kun gang 23)bar bsam: gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ dbyings nas drangs pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnamasaḥ dam tshig 'khor lo'i rten dang dbyer med par: chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin ro gcig tu: pad nyi bam gyi gdan la gnyis med bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥtiṣ+ṭha lhan: ces brjod dam tshig ye shes gnyis: chu la chu bur thim pa bzhin: gnyis med gsang gsum ro gcig bsam: gsum pa phyag 'tshal niḥ na mo: rang byung ye shes byang chub sems: dkyil 'khor kun gyi ngo bor gnas: lha dang rang snang gnyis med pa'i: rang ngo rang zhal mjal phyag 'tshal: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ bzhi pa mchod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ keṃ las rin chen bhan+dha yangs pa'i nang: zag med 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod pa ni: gzung 'dzin bdag lta'i ru tra'i dbang yul dang: phung khams skye mched longs spyod snang yul kun: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: bzhes nas sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor bdag cag la: drag po mthu yi dngos grub stsol ba dang: phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra ku mā ra sa pā ri wa ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs 24)shap+da rū pa= dharma pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā: ma hā sarba pañtsa ba liṃ ta rak+ta gu h+ya pū dza khā hiḥ zhes brjod rang las sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams bde stong ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mnyes nas gzi byin mchog tu rgyas par bsam: lnga pa bstod pa ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ chos dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs kyi bdag:

che ba'i che mchog badz+ra ku mā ra: phrin las yongs rdzogs dpal la phyag 'tshal bstod: sgeg dpa' 'jigs su rung ba sku yi gar: rgod gshe drag shul ldan pa gsung gi gar: snying rje rngams zhi rdzogs pa thugs kyi gar: gar dgu'i nyams rdzogs rdo rje gzhon nur bstod: stong nyid gdangs las gang 'dul skur sprul pa: sna tshogs thabs kyis 'khor 'das rgyas 'debs shing: rnam kun mchog ldan don gyi rnal 'byor ma: yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs nyid la bstod: dpal chen yab yum thugs las sprul pa'i sras: kī la rigs bzhi khro bcu khra thabs dang: sgo ma bzhi dang phur srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces brjod sku gsung thugs kyi lha mo yis: snyan 25)dbyangs rol lo sogs kyi bstod par bsam: mthar ni de dag rang gi thugs kar bsdu: rgyal kun phrin las dbang rnams rdzogs bar bsam: drug pa bshags pani: hoḥ rtsa gsum rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas: sgo gsum mi dge'i las kun bzod par gsol: mi bsgrib tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya sogs/ āḥ zhes brjod bskyed bzlas g.yel nas dang: sgo gsum bag med nyes tshogs kunaḥ ba mor nyi zer phog pa ltar: ma lus byang zhing dag sangs nas: sgo gsum dkyil 'khor gsum du bsre: lta ba lha yi gding ldan bya: bdun pa 'dzab dmigs gsal ba ni: hūm̐: gtso bo'i thugs kar pad+ma nyi ma'i steng: ye shes sems dpa' rgyan med tshon gang pa'i: thugs klong nyi steng gnam lcags rdo rje'i lter: thabs shes nyi zla'i gwa'u kha sbyor nang: hūm̐ mthing nyid la rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor: bzlas pas sgo gsum rdo rje gsum du smin: rgyal kun phrin las gsang gsum yongs 'dus bsam: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: 'di ni rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa'o: sngags phreng g.yas su mgal me ltar 'khor las:

'od zer 26)kha dog sna lnga phyogs bcur 'phros: dbyings bzhugs bde gshegs sras bcas mchod pas mnyes: thugs rje byin rlabs gzi byin dbang dngos grub: 'od lnga'i rnam par tshur 'dus rang la thim: sgo gsum dag rdzogs smin gsum mthar phyin te: mthu nus gzi byin rab tu rgyas pa dang: snang grags lha sngags chos nyid chen por sangs: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥhūm̐ āḥ 'di ni nye bar bsnyen pa sgrub pa'o: slar yang sngags phreng mgal me lug brgyud ltar: yab yum zhal gsang bar brgyud mdun bskyed bskul: de la 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rgyal rnams kyi: thugs rje byin rlabs zhing dang gzhal yas dang: snang srid bcud dang dpal yon ma lus pa: 'od kyi rnam par bsdus te bdag mdun la: chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin gnyis med gyur: snang srid dag mnyam 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang: lhun grub mi gnas bde ba chen por āḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ ho: ka taṃ ka ye: dza ye bi dza ye: a dzi te: a pa ra dzi te: mā ra se na pra mar+dha na ye sarba 27)bigh+nāṃ bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ 'di ni sgrub pa chen po'o: bdag mdun rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi: sku las 'od dang 'od phung rab 'phros pas: las byed pho nya bya khyung lcags sdig sogs: skar ltar 'khrigs nas snang srid bar med gang: gzugs can gzugs med dgra bgegs gnod byed dang: tshe bsod bar gcod gdon bgegs ma lus kun: thal ba'i rdul bzhin rjes shul med par brlag: sha khrag srog dbugs nang rol bcas pa kun: za byed pho nya'i tshogs kyis lhag med rol: 'khrul mi shes pa'i dbyings su grol thob nas: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub par bsam: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭaḥ gnod byed sarba shā truṃ mā ra ya phaṭaḥ 'di ni las sbyor rim pa'o: man ngag spu gri'i sngags gzer gdab: 'di yis lha srin bran khol nas:

bar chad g.yul las rgyal bar 'gyur: zla ba drug tu bzlas bsgrub bya: mchog gi rig 'dzin sar gshegs nas: dngos grub rnam gnyis thob par nges: srog ni rig pa byang chub sems: 'gyur ba med pa chos kyi sku: sdom ni 'khor dang 'das pa ste: mtha' grol klong yangs lha ba'o: sdom byed gzer bzhi'i man ngag ni: snang rtog lha yi 28)phrag rgya ru: shes pa gsal ba'i gzer dang ni: sgra grags thams cad sngags kyi sgra: rlung sngags dbyer med sngags kyi gzer: dran rtog 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang: 'gyu 'phro ye shes phrin las gzer: ye nas ma btsal lhun gyis grub: 'di don tshul bzhin shes gyur na: bskyed rdzogs rnam grangs mang mi dgos: 'di yis dngos grub ma lus thob: the tshom med do sa ma ya: e ma gsang ba las kyang ches gsang ba: yang zab sgrub pa kun gyi snying po mchog: pra bha hasti'i thugs kyi yang snying 'di: pad+ma saṃ bhas gces pa'i nor bzhin du: kho mo mtsho rgyal bdag la gnang ba yi: snying mig srog las phongs shing ches zab pas: zhi ba rdo rje mtsho yi thugs dam mdzod: da dung ma spel rin chen gter du sbos: ma 'ongs snyigs 'dus nyi shu kha ral dus: chos sgrub nyung zhi dam med lung pa gang: mdo sngags gnyis kyi chos la rtsod gzhi byed: chos spangs las ngan sap+ta'i dbang song nas: sngags la gshe zhing dkor la rtsi bzhin mthong: sgrub pa'i dben gnas bya spyang phag gis 'dzin: dge slong khrims nyams khyim pa'i khrod du 'grim: sngags pas dam nyams bskyed rdzogs rlung la bskur: skye bos mna' za rkun jag las la brtson: yul mi rnams kyi cha lugs ma nges pa: hor nag rgya dang srin po'i chas gos byed: dkon mchog rgyab ston phung rdzas skyabs su 'tshol: rang byas las kyi rnamasmin du 29)smin nas: sa la 'bru med nam zla'i drod mi snyoms: dbyar dgun go ldog bza' shing bcud mi 'phel: 'gro rnams dbul zhing rong tsho spyang ltar 'khyams:

stod kyi khu 'phang smad du ngoms pa'i tshe: mi bde'i sdug bsngal rin gyis nyos 'dra 'ong: de dus chos sgrub bu la bar chad mang: rang nyid bdud kyis bslus nas chos las log: nye 'brel bdud du babs nas chos las log: bud med bdud du babs nas chos las log: pha ma bdud du babs nas chos las log: longs spyod bdud du babs nas chos las log: gnas khang bdud du babs nas chos las log: yul spyod bdud du babs nas chos las log: log pa bdud kyi bstan pa dar ba'i tshe: zab chos 'di nyid yid bzhin nor las lhag: de dus nga sprul nga dang gnyis med pa: zhi ba rdo rje mtsho yis chos 'di bton: 'dir 'phrad chos sgrub skyes bu'i bar chad sel: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: skal med log lta can la 'di ma 'phrad: bka' srung dregs pa rnam gsum gnyer gyis shig: dam nyams lag tu ma shor a thaṃ rgya: sa ma ya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang rang lo zhe gcig lor mkha' 'gro ral gri 'bar mas gter dpe dngos su gnang ba la brten nas brda ji bzhin par ma khrol yang rten 'brel gyi ched du nye 30)gnas shī la badz+ra gyis gtsos bu slob chos bdag rnams kyi tshe 'phrang sel ba'i phyir du ser dgon dben khrod 'od gsal dga' ba'i ljongs shod nas skyes dman bde ba'i rdo rjes nyams chos yig ris su bris pa'o// dge'o//
